facts.description: Gemini 4 Argon (gemini-4-argon) is our efficient Gemini 4 frontier reasoning model. It delivers Gemini 4 intelligence with faster responses and lower token spend per turn compared to Gemini 4 Carbon across complex coding, agentic, math, and science tasks. Like Carbon, it supports a unified 1M-token context window and long decode up to 1M tokens.
